newsitem.title: UK: London & Manchester sees H1 new business up.
newsitem.headline: London & Manchester sees H1 new business up.

text.p: UK life and corporate pensions company London and Manchester Group Plc said on Wednesday it expected its first-half new business results to show a "good improvement" over year-ago figures.
The company said new business at its Home Service Business Centres was running at very encouraging levels, while momentum had been maintained, particularly at its Industrial Branch.
"The other activities of the group continue to make progress," the company said in a statement from its annual meeting.
